heading: ItineraryByWaypoints
text: An itinerary geometry encoded as an ordered sequence of features (waypoints).

heading: PointGeometryList
text: An ordered list of member point geometries.

heading: PositionConfidenceEllipse
text: A confidence ellipse describing uncertainty of a point position in a horizontal plane.

heading: PointByProjectedCoordinates
text: A point location geometry encoded as projected coordinates and optional elements, such as elevation and metadata.

heading: AreaByMultiPolygon
text: An area geometry encoded as a MultiPolygon geometry.

heading: PointFeature
text: A spatial feature with no length in any of the spatial dimensions (a point phenomenon in space).

heading: LinearGeometry
text: A geometry that encodes a linear location using a specific method.

heading: PointByCoordinates
text: A coordinate tuple defining the geodetic position of a single point location using a known geodetic reference system

heading: Elevation
text: An elevation for a point location along with metadata.

heading: FeatureList
text: An ordered list of member features (e.g., itinerary waypoints).

heading: AreaByRectangle
text: An area geometry encoded as a rectangle, defined by a lower-left corner and an upper-right corner.

heading: LinearByPointGeometries
text: A linear geometry encoded as an ordered sequence of point geometries.

heading: AreaFeature
text: A spatial feature enclosed within a two-dimensional boundary or boundaries across a defined surface.

heading: LocationGroup
text: An unordered set of multiple physically separate features (each typically a singular feature with its own geometry).

heading: ItineraryGeometry
text: A geometry that encodes an itinerary using a specific method.

heading: FacilityCode
text: A code that identifies a type of facility.

heading: Itinerary
text: An ordered set of multiple physically separate features forming a route or itinerary.

heading: PointByCode
text: A point geometry whose coordinates are not modelled here but can be resolved using :hasLookupCode and an external location referencing system.

heading: MeasurementErrorCode
text: A code identifying an error condition or qualification for a measurement value.

heading: LinearByCode
text: A linear geometry whose extent is not modelled here but can be resolved using :hasLookupCode and an external location referencing system.

heading: LocationCode
text: A code that identifies (or can be used to look up) a location in some external referencing system.

heading: LocationThing
text: Parent class for location domain concepts.

heading: AreaByLinearBoundaries
text: An area geometry encoded as a set of linear boundary geometries.

heading: PointByGeoCoordinates
text: A point location geometry encoded as latitude/longitude and optional elements, such as elevation and metadata.

heading: AreaByGrid
text: An area geometry encoded as a grid. The rectangle defined by lower-left and upper-right is the base cell, which is replicated eastward (columns) and northward (rows).

heading: CodedGeometry
text: A geometry whose extent is resolved via an external code, registry, or service (a pointer to a geometry held elsewhere).

heading: AreaGeometry
text: A geometry that encodes an area location using a specific method.

heading: ItineraryCode
text: An itinerary geometry whose route geometry is not modelled here but can be resolved using :hasLookupCode and an external itinerary/route referencing system.

heading: PositionAccuracy
text: A statement of positional accuracy for a point geometry.

heading: AreaByPolygon
text: An area geometry encoded as a Polygon geometry.

heading: LinearByLinearRing
text: A linear geometry encoded as a LinearRing geometry.

heading: LinearByPointFeatures
text: A linear geometry encoded as an ordered sequence of points.

heading: PointGeometry
text: A geometry for a point location using a specific method (e.g., coordinates or an external code).

heading: Geometry
text: A description of a spatial location in the real world according to a defined reference system.

heading: LinearByMultiLineString
text: A linear geometry encoded as a MultiLineString geometry.

heading: Feature
text: An abstraction of real-world phenomena. An ITS-domain feature (subclass of geo:Feature) used to model real-world things that have a spatial location.

heading: LinearByLineString
text: A linear geometry encoded as a LineString geometry.

heading: AreaByCircle
text: An area geometry encoded as a circle.

heading: CoordinateGeometry
text: A geometry that is represented by a coordinate system (i.e., directly encodes coordinate tuples).

heading: AreaByCode
text: An area geometry whose extent is not modelled here but can be resolved using :hasLookupCode and an external location referencing system.

heading: PointFeatureList
text: An ordered list of member point features.

heading: OffsetDistance
text: An offset distance expressed either as a length or as a percentage.

heading: CoordinateReferenceSystem
text: A coordinate reference system (CRS) used to interpret coordinate tuples in a CoordinateGeometry. Typically identified using an OGC CRS IRI such as http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/4326.

heading: ElevationAccuracy
text: A statement of elevation accuracy for a point geometry.

heading: DistanceAccuracy
text: A statement of distance accuracy for a point geometry.

heading: LinearFeature
text: A spatial feature that extends along a defined path (typically between two point features or along a network element).

heading: PointByLinearPosition
text: A point geometry defined by an offset along a linear geometry.

heading: ElevationHeightCode
text: A code that identifies the height value for an elevation value  (e.g., 'ground layer 1', 'elevated layer 1', 'elevated layer 2', 'tunnel layer 1').

heading: SpatialObject
text: A spatial object within the ITS domain (subclass of geo:SpatialObject).

heading: ElevationReferenceCode
text: A code that identifies the reference system for an elevation value  (e.g., 'ellipsoidal', 'gravityRelated', 'ground level', 'EPSG:5701', 'coded height').

heading: hasElevation
text: Associates a point geometry with an elevation value.

heading: hasElevationDistance
text: Elevation distance of a point location, as measured from the elevation reference system.

heading: hasElevationHeightCode
text: Coded elevation height value of a point location.

heading: hasElevationReference
text: Reference system for the elevation value.

heading: hasElevationAccuracy
text: Associates a point geometry with an elevation accuracy statement.

heading: hasPositionAccuracy
text: Associates a point geometry with a statement of positional accuracy.

heading: hasPositionConfidenceEllipse
text: Associates a point geometry with a confidence ellipse statement.

heading: hasDistanceAccuracy
text: The upper limit of the accuracy, expressed as a simple length value (e.g., within 10 meters).

heading: confidencePercentage
text: Percent confidence in a reported value as defined by the percentile of the cumulative distribution of position errors (e.g., 95% confidence).

heading: distanceAccuracyErrorCode
text: A code that identifies the error code for a distance accuracy value.

heading: semiMajorAxisLength
text: Semi-major axis length of the confidence ellipse.

heading: semiMinorAxisLength
text: Semi-minor axis length of the confidence ellipse.

heading: semiMajorAxisOrientation
text: Orientation of the semi-major axis of the confidence ellipse.

heading: semiMajorAxisLengthErrorCode
text: A code qualifying the semi-major axis length measurement.

heading: semiMinorAxisLengthErrorCode
text: A code qualifying the semi-minor axis length measurement.

heading: semiMajorAxisOrientationErrorCode
text: A code qualifying the semi-major axis orientation measurement.

heading: bearing
text: Bearing of a point location.

heading: hasLinearBoundary
text: Associates an area geometry with linear features that define its boundary.

heading: hasCenter
text: Center point of a circle area geometry.

heading: radius
text: Radius of a circle area geometry.

heading: hasLowerLeft
text: Lower-left (southwestern) point of a rectangle area geometry.

heading: hasUpperRight
text: Upper-right (northeastern) point of a rectangle area geometry.

heading: hasPointList
text: Associates LinearByPointFeatures with its ordered list of member points.

heading: hasPointGeometryList
text: Associates LinearByPointGeometries with its ordered list of member point geometries.

heading: hasOffsetDistance
text: Associates a PointByLinearPosition with its offset distance value.

heading: offsetLength
text: Length form of an offset distance.

heading: offsetPercentage
text: Percentage form of an offset distance.

heading: alongLinearGeometry
text: Associates a PointByLinearPosition with the linear geometry along which it is located.

heading: basePoint
text: The base/reference point from which the offset is measured.

heading: directionPoint
text: A second point used to establish the direction of offset relative to the basePoint.

heading: locationContainedInItinerary
text: DATEX-aligned property name for associating an itinerary by waypoints with its ordered list of member features.

heading: hasWaypointList
text: Associates an itinerary by waypoints with its ordered list of member features (waypoints).

heading: LocationObjectProperty
text: Organizational super-property for location core object properties.

heading: hasMember
text: Relates a location group to a member feature.

heading: hasLookupCode
text: Associates a coded geometry with the location code used to retrieve or resolve its geometric extent in an external system.

heading: geometryOf
text: Inverse of geo:hasGeometry: relates a geometry to the feature it represents.

heading: hasCRS
text: Associates a CoordinateGeometry with the coordinate reference system used to interpret its coordinate tuples.

heading: latitude
text: Latitude of a point coordinate (decimal degrees; CRS implied or supplied by the geometry context).

heading: longitude
text: Longitude of a point coordinate (decimal degrees; CRS implied or supplied by the geometry context).

heading: northing
text: The northerly (y) dimension of a point coordinate expressed in some linear unit.

heading: easting
text: The easterly (x) dimension of a point coordinate expressed in some linear unit.

heading: numColumns
text: Number of times the base rectangle cell is replicated eastward in a grid area geometry. The width of the area is the width of the base cell multiplied by the number of columns.

heading: numRows
text: Number of times the base rectangle cell is replicated northward in a grid area geometry. The height of the area is the height of the base cell multiplied by the number of rows.

heading: LocationDataProperty
text: Organizational super-property for location core data properties.

heading: coordinateEpoch
text: The epoch (observation/realization time) at which the coordinate tuples of a CoordinateGeometry are valid in its CRS. Needed for dynamic reference frames.
